marc:datafield.marc:subfield: After being exposed as Divergents - people who don't fit neatly into one of the five societal classifications or "factions" - Tris (Shailene Woodley) and Four (Theo James) find themselves on the run from Jeanine (Kate Winslet), the power-hungry leader of the Erudite factions. As the traitorous Dauntless troops under Jeanine's command prowl the ruins of dystopian Chicago rounding up Divergents, Tris and Four traverse the city hoping to find allies among the Amity, Candor, Abnegation,and Dauntless factions - as well as the rebellious and impoverished mass of Factionless...
